about: Documented schema differences between the sdk-ts and sdk-rs identity outcome exports: fields one SDK reports and the other does not, each with the corpus, case (glob or list), step (absent: the case itself; "*": any step; a number), field (dotted glob: * inside a key is any characters, a ** key any number of keys), the side that reports it, and why. A conflict-view entry (`conflict_set`: the side that reports `<field>_conflict_set`, the other reporting `<field>`) documents a §4 rule 2 conflict only when the one value is a member of the set; otherwise it is a divergence. Anything else one side lacks is a divergence (scripts/identity-differential.mjs); an entry that covers nothing is stale.

differences.why: IDENTITY-PROFILE-01 §4 rule 2: a field, or a roster/devices entry, with concurrent values. sdk-ts reports `<key>_conflict_set`, every concurrent value (the convention of the corpus's own entry inputs); sdk-rs reports `<key>`, one value, which must be one of them (a reader MAY show any concurrent value, never another). Same merged document, two views (spec question 6).
